delta.text: page was shifted one page too

content.text:
I fixed the bug and all 4 tests pass now.

**Cause:** `src/offset.js` was computing `page * perPage`, which assumes page numbers start at 0. The tests number pages from 1, so every page was shifted one page too far. Page 1 returned issues 7–3 instead of 12–8, and page 3 came back empty instead of returning `[2, 1]`.

**Fix:** I changed it to `(page - 1) * perPage` in `src/offset.js:1`. `src/page.js` is the only file that uses `offset`, so nothing else is affected. I haven't committed the change.
